metadata.title: Letícia Marinho — Learning Designer
metadata.description: Portfolio of Letícia Marinho — Learning Experience Designer with 10+ years creating human, innovative, and impactful learning experiences.

hero.subtitle: Transforming educational technology into meaningful learning experiences
hero.name: Letícia Marinho

about.title: Passionate about transforming
about.para1: I work at CDI Portugal, where I develop and coordinate educational projects in programming, robotics and digital literacy at the Digital Citizenship Centre of Valongo and the Carlos Fiolhais Innovation Centre in Maia.
about.para2: I specialise in the pedagogical design of STEAM activities, technology clubs and projects with a strong hands-on component — educational robotics, artificial intelligence, gamification and digital citizenship.

stats.quote: "Education should be practical, meaningful and connected to the real world."

work.title: real instructional
work.description: Each project is a case study with real context, approach, tools and outcomes.

approach.title: My instructional design process
approach.curriculumNote: All technology activities presented in this portfolio are developed based on the Portuguese national curriculum and adapted to the age level of participants.

steps.title: Educational Context Analysis
steps.description: I identify the target audience, real learning needs and institutional context before designing any activity.

steps.title: National Curriculum Alignment
steps.description: All activities are developed based on the Portuguese national curriculum and the curricular goals for the corresponding school year.

steps.title: Learning Objectives Definition
steps.description: I define clear, measurable objectives aligned with digital competencies, computational thinking and digital citizenship.

steps.title: Hands-On Experience Design
steps.description: I use active methodologies: Project-Based Learning, STEAM, Design Thinking and active learning with a hands-on component.

steps.title: Implementation with Educational Technology
steps.description: I integrate tools like Scratch, Arduino, Makey Makey, mBot and educational robotics as amplifiers of the learning process.

steps.title: Assessment and Continuous Improvement
steps.description: I observe student performance, collect evidence and iterate activities based on real process feedback.

pillars.title: Instructional Design
pillars.description: Needs analysis, measurable objectives and real impact assessment.

pillars.title: Active Learning
pillars.description: PBL, gamification, hands-on and deliberate practice as core methodologies.

pillars.title: Educational Technology
pillars.description: Tools that amplify — not replace — human learning.

pillars.title: User Experience
pillars.description: Clarity, flow and friction reduction at every moment of the experience.

pillars.title: Real Impact
pillars.description: Evidence, continuous iteration and verifiable behavioural change.

footer.title: Let's create something
footer.description: Available for instructional design projects, LXD, training and EdTech consulting.
footer.tagline: 10+ years of experience in instructional design and educational technology
